note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Steps of browser/app screens are done by hand by the person recording.

screens.name: eventstream-live
steps: Workspace Contoso Sales (Lab) > eventstream es-till-events in Live view: custom endpoint source, Eventhouse destination (direct ingestion, table TillEventsRaw)

Terminal inset at C:\MGLab\power-bi\ep17\src, about 40 seconds before a whole minute: $env:TILLSTREAM_CONNECTION_STRING = Read-Host 'Event Hub connection string' -MaskInput (typed off camera), then python -m tillstream send --run-id demo17
Data preview of the eventstream: JSON rows arriving
After ten minutes show the sender summary: messages, unique EventId, duplicates, late events, amount
mask: endpoint namespace and connection string (never show keys)

screens.name: kql-totals
steps: KQL queryset qs-till on database ContosoLive: run totals-check.kql (Events, Units, Amount for RunId demo17) and compare with the sender summary
Run duplicates.kql (ExtraRows equals the sender's duplicates) and late-arrivals.kql (P50, P95, LateOverTwoMinutes)
Keep the sender summary visible beside it; record the real numbers and latency

screens.name: desktop-page-refresh
steps: Open C:\MGLab\power-bi\ep17\src\ContosoLive.pbip; Edit parameters KqlClusterUri and KqlDatabase (values masked); sign in as labadmin; storage mode DirectQuery on Till Events
Page Live tills: cards Sales Amount, Orders, Last Event Time; line chart Orders by minute (Axis EventTime, Legend Channel); column chart Sales Amount by Store
Format > Page refresh: On, Change detection, measure Last Event Time, every 5 seconds; show details
With the sender running, show the cards and the line moving without a click; one short cut with an Import-mode scratch pbix where the Page refresh card is missing
mask: account name and picture at the top right of Power BI Desktop (sign out first)
Windows user name in any file path (record from C:\MGLab)

screens.name: realtime-dashboard
steps: Real-Time Dashboard Live tills on the KQL database: tiles from live-kpis.kql, sales-per-minute.kql, orders-per-minute-anomaly.kql
Manage > Refresh settings > Live refresh on; record the refresh rate limit chosen
With the sender running show the tiles updating without a reload; the anomaly tile lists the flash-sale minutes

screens.name: apr-minimum
steps: Publish the report from Desktop to Contoso Sales (Lab); semantic model settings: set the Azure Data Explorer credentials
Open the report > Edit > Format > Page refresh: set 1 second and show the allowed minimum and its message
As capacity admin: Admin portal > Capacity settings > Power BI workloads: show the automatic page refresh settings if the trial exposes them, or record that they are not available

teardown: # owner: delete the Fabric items Eventhouse ContosoLive, queryset qs-till, eventstream es-till-events, dashboard Live tills, report and model Contoso Live from the workspace
owner_notes: Owner setup off camera (demo.md Setup 1-10): eventhouse, schema, eventstream with custom endpoint and Eventhouse destination, dashboard, Desktop report. Sender run: python -m tillstream send --run-id demo17 (rehearse with --run-id rehearsal --speed 10; expect 368 rows). The connection string never appears in a file.
